_comment: The field study phase that ends the session with a close on its way (#630), alone: the stop waits for the close and books its fill before the session ends. Its suite also runs it on the stop before #630, where the phase has to fail.

deployment._comment: Do this profile's sessions form ONE deployment whose ledger rows join into one history? MANDATORY — there is no safe default. Declare true only on a profile you are actually deploying; the CLI can narrow it (--one-off) but never widen it.

decision_logic_config._comment: Replayed time runs far ahead of the mock venue's answers, so the open gets an hour of it: its fill is answered at once and booked on a later pass, never inside a fifteen-second window for certain (#494).
